scope: Frozen v9 development membership with a routine 192-tick budget and the shortest long-horizon representative per backend/family/difficulty_mode stratum. The cutoff is an efficiency budget, not a scientific definition of long-horizon agency. Native ticks are not wall-time or API-call guarantees. Core membership is unchanged.
evidence_boundary: Historical model-based selection remains a development-set bias; pre-repair zero/ceiling scores and infrastructure failures do not justify further exclusions. Repaired CPU greedy completes all six Dyna schedules.
